title: arenaria stricta var. litorea
intro: Arenaria stricta var. litorea, commonly known as sea campion, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). It is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing, due to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in Arenaria stricta var. litorea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the plant's efficacy and potential applications in traditional medicine.
